prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a vibrant rooftop party under the night sky. On the left, a woman in a silver dress stands holding a champagne flute, her posture relaxed as she gazes toward the center. Next to her sits a black cat on a wooden crate, its eyes reflecting the ambient city lights. In the center, a man in a blue suit leans against a railing, pointing excitedly at the distant skyline while talking to a woman in a green jacket who is looking at him with amusement. To the right, a large potted palm tree sways slightly in the breeze, its fronds casting shadows on the concrete floor. Beside the plant, a teenager in a hoodie sits on a low wall, scrolling through a phone with intense focus. Behind them, a waiter in a white apron walks past carrying a tray of appetizers, balancing it carefully with one hand. The scene is illuminated by string lights overhead, creating a warm glow on the faces of the guests. There is no swimming pool visible in the frame. The composition emphasizes the casual elegance of the gathering, with each individual engaged in their own moment yet connected by the shared space. The city lights blur softly in the background, providing depth without distracting from the foreground subjects. The textures of the clothing, the fur of the cat, and the leaves of the plant are rendered with high fidelity, showcasing the realism of the image.
